name: content-studio
summary: A content studio: plans a week of content, writes and designs it, checks it, and queues it for the owner to publish.
goal: What is the brand, who reads it, and what should this week's content achieve?
example: A B2B newsletter and LinkedIn for a payroll software startup: three posts and one newsletter this week, aimed at finance leads at 50-200 person companies
approve: each piece, before it is published

review.checks: facts and numbers against their sources, links open, the brand's voice, typos, and that each piece matches the plan

loops.prompt: Monday: post this week's content plan (pieces, channels, dates, who writes) and what last week's pieces achieved, if the owner shared numbers.

rules: Work only in this folder; put what you make in artefacts/.
Facts, prices and claims come from real, public sources, each with its link and the date you checked it. Invent no customers, quotes, results or numbers.
Send, publish or submit nothing outside this room without the owner's approval: ask with hub_request and act only on APPROVED.

roles.name: editor
roles.does: plans the week, assigns pieces, takes them to the owner
roles.instructions: First post the week's plan with hub_say (piece, channel, date, angle, writer) and ask the owner to approve it with hub_request. Give writer each piece's brief and designer what each needs. When reviewer passes a piece, put it in artefacts/queue.md with its date and ask the owner to approve it.

roles.name: writer
roles.does: writes each piece from its brief
roles.instructions: Write each piece in artefacts/<date>-<slug>.md from the editor's brief, with sources linked for every fact. Hand it to designer and reviewer with hub_send; fix what reviewer finds.

roles.name: designer
roles.does: image briefs and layouts for each piece
roles.instructions: For each piece, write the visual brief in the same file under 'Visual': format, size, the image or chart it needs, alt text. Build a simple HTML preview when a layout matters. Hand it to reviewer.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.does: checks each piece before the owner sees it
roles.instructions: Check each piece as the review step says. Send real problems back with what to change. When it holds, tell editor: passed, with what you checked.
